pageCache.pageTitle: St Mary's Lewisham CE Primary School - Faith Group
pageCache.text:
Faith Group
Our children's Faith Group are elected to support worship, prayer and learning in RE across the School.
Easter Fayre
Planned and organised by our amazing children's Faith Group, the school community joined together to raise money at our Easter Fayre. The money raised will be donated to the charities supported by the Bishop of Southwark's Lent Appeal - including projects in Zimbabwe, Palestine and London. The children in the Faith Group included many exciting activities that were enjoyed by everyone - a cake sale, Easter egg hunt, egg painting, hook an Easter duck and an egg and spoon obstacle race.
Prayer Day
A day of Prayer, Reflection and Peace was planned and led by the children's Faith Group. Each child in the school enjoyed 4 activities, which linked to our school values:
Prayer Day 2025
St Mary's Church and Therapeutic Garden were the perfect setting for a day of Prayer, Reflection and Peace.

pageCache.pageTitle: St Mary's Lewisham CE Primary School - Headteacher's Welcome
pageCache.text:
Headteacher's Welcome
​Welcome to St Mary’s Lewisham Church of England Primary School.I am proud to be the Headteacher of our inclusive, nurturing and aspirational school community, where every child is known, valued and encouraged to thrive. Children are happy, enthusiastic learners who are supported to be curious, reflective and confident as they grow academically, socially and spiritually.
Our Christian vision and values are at the heart of daily life at St Mary’s. They shape our curriculum, guide our relationships and underpin the way we conduct ourselves. We believe that every child is uniquely made, with gifts and potential to be discovered, nurtured and celebrated. Through a culture of kindness, respect and high expectations, we support our pupils to develop resilience, compassion and a strong sense of self-worth.
Learning at St Mary’s is purposeful, engaging and meaningful. We are committed to providing rich experiences that inspire curiosity and creativity, deepen understanding and foster a love of learning. The wellbeing of our children is central to all that we do, and we work hard to ensure they feel safe, supported and confident in their learning.
We place great importance on partnership with parents and carers. Children thrive best when school and home work together, and we value open communication, trust and shared responsibility. We are an approachable school community and welcome the voices, ideas and involvement of our families.
As Headteacher, I am committed to ensuring that every decision we make is rooted in the best interests of the children we serve. I look forward to welcoming your family into our school community and working together to help every child flourish.
Christine GrahamHeadteacher

pageCache.pageTitle: St Mary's Lewisham CE Primary School - Worship
pageCache.text:
Worship
Mrs Graham, our Headteacher, leads us in worship every day. We join together as a school community to reflect in an atmosphere of Peace and Respect. Bible readings are used to help us to learn how we can live our school values. A combination of music, song, drama, artefacts and storytelling bring the worship to life for the children.
Worship at St Mary's School

pageCache.pageTitle: St Mary's Lewisham CE Primary School - Faith
pageCache.text:
Faith
We reflect on our own faith and what this means to us personally. We also recognise that learning about a diverse range of other faiths can help us to strengthen our own faith. We also reflect on how we can have faith in ourselves and others - with faith there is nothing that we can't achieve. On this page you will find lots of links to resources and ideas to help you explore and reflect on the value of Faith. ​You will also see many examples of this value in action at St Mary's.
Faith
Key Themes to Explore
Key concepts to unpack
Hebrews 11:1 ​‘Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives ​us proof of what we cannot see.’
Luke 1:37 ​‘For nothing will be impossible with God.’

Values in Action
Learning at the Migration Museum​Did you know that there is a fabulous museum which is free in the middle of Lewisham Shopping Centre? It's called the Migration Museum and it's right next two the two pieces of stone which come from the Berlin Wall.Year 5 and Year 6 visited the museum and found out all sorts of interesting facts about migrants and immigrants. There were letters and postcards to read based on real people's experiences, a kitchen where people shared their love of food and recipes from many different countries and a classroom where children read poems composed by young people coming to the UK and having to start school.As a School of Sanctuary we are especially sensitive to the needs of people who may be escaping war or violence and we talked about what sanctuary means for people. We have Faith that they can find Sanctuary and a warm welcome.
